qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Mid-tier Spanish commercial and SME bank lacking dominant scale; 5-year median ROE of ~6.8% is far below the 12% cycle hurdle, with profitability heavily dependent on ECB interest rate peaks and vulnerable to price competition from larger rivals (CaixaBank, BBVA, Santander).
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (3b='N', REJECT). Banco Sabadell is a mid-tier Spanish SME and retail bank lacking a defensible moat against larger domestic competitors. 5-year median ROE of ~6.8% falls well short of the 12% cycle hurdle, with returns only briefly reaching double digits during peak ECB interest rates.
qualitative.evidence: Spain's 4th largest bank with ~7% domestic loan market share, plus UK subsidiary TSB. Historical ROE track record: 2019 (6.0%), 2020 (0.0%), 2021 (4.1%), 2022 (6.8%), 2023 (9.6%), and 2024 (12.2%), yielding a 5-year median ROE well below 12%. Sub-scale in retail and digital banking compared to CaixaBank, Santander, and BBVA, making it the target of an unsolicited hostile takeover bid by BBVA.
